author: fwyzard
body:
LZ4 v1.10.0 introduces major updates:
  - multithreading support
  - dictionary compression and decompression
  - new "medium" compression level 2

For the full set of changes sinze LZ4 v1.9.2, see:
  - https://github.com/lz4/lz4/releases#release-v1.10.0
  - https://github.com/lz4/lz4/releases#release-v1.9.4
  - https://github.com/lz4/lz4/releases#release-v1.9.3
title: Update lz4 to v1.10.0
